breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) were specified for the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly omits the conflicting Dirichlet condition and only states the Neumann conditions, aligning with the ground truth.
